v2.0.1 agent-managed registration: script-assisted signup, one-click login links, Alipay subscription and payment tracking, bundled screenshots (assets/screenshots), updated command contract (login-link --target, gen-password, prepare-suggest, whoami).
Localize display name; align search keywords with per-language translations; add categories

Initial release of powpow-register-am — a pure guidance skill for PowPow (Bubble) account registration and activation.

- Step-by-step user guidance for Bubble account registration and membership activation, in Amharic.
- Handles common registration issues (verification code not received, username/email taken, password format) and post-signup problems (account not activated, payment/activation).
- Clearly separates what is covered: only guidance, troubleshooting, and pointers to screenshots/examples — no product posting or account creation actions.
- Provides up-to-date references for each stage, including flows, payment/activation, and illustrated screenshots.
- Outlines strict UX and privacy rules: never ask for passwords or codes, only offer advice and user's next actions.
